title: BattleFrame: Dirtside II
description: Dirtside II (GZG) ruleset for the BattleFrame system — a battalion-scale sci-fi armour engine. This module implements the game MECHANICS only; it ships no rulebook text, no artwork, no cost tables, no colour-validity tables, and no proprietary unit stat blocks. You supply your own unit data and populate the damage-chit pot yourself. Free and non-commercial.
